# Implemented Recommendations

## Format

### [Recommendation Title]
**Implemented**: [YYYY-MM-DD]  
**Original Priority**: [High / Medium / Low]  
**Category**: [Code Quality / Performance / Architecture / Testing]  
**Description**: [What was done]  
**Outcome**: [Results and impact]  
**Related Work**: [Keys or commits]

## Notes

- Recommendations move here from `active-recommendations.md` when completed
- Documents history of improvements
- Helps track project evolution
- Provides evidence of continuous improvement
